0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder host the Washington Wizards in their 10th game of the season, with the Thunder (7-2, 4-0 at home) riding a three-game win streak and sitting 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West, while the Wizards (4-5, on a two-game losing streak) are 8th in the East and 1.5 games back of the top spot in the Southeast. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber, and Washington is missing Anthony Davis, Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Thunder won both games of their 2025-26 series, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21, 2026.
